name: yfinance
description: Yahoo Finance 무료 API — 60년치 일봉, 분기·연간 재무 시계열, 옵션 체인, 다종목 일괄 다운로드. **실시간 시세와 주문은 없습니다** — 실시간 시세는 korea-invest·kiwoom·toss-invest, 주문은 *-trade 모듈입니다. 비공식 API라 분당 30회 안쪽으로 부르십시오.

action.description: Action. quote=current price + key metrics / history=OHLCV time series / info=symbol metadata (100+ fields) / financials=financial statements / dividends=dividends / splits=stock splits / recommendations=analyst recommendations / options=options chain / holders=major and institutional holders / news=Yahoo news / download=multi-symbol batch (uses the symbols array) / page_blocks = page-binding blocks (metric + stock_chart) for the page module block — {symbol, period?, interval?}

symbol.description: Symbol code. US = bare (AAPL, MSFT). KOSPI = .KS, KOSDAQ = .KQ (005930.KS, 035720.KQ); Japan .T (7203.T), UK .L (BARC.L). FX = KRW=X, JPYKRW=X. Indices = ^KS11, ^KQ11, ^GSPC, ^IXIC. Crypto = BTC-USD. Commodities = GC=F (gold), CL=F (crude). Required by every action except 'download', which takes either this or the symbols array.

symbols.description: Multiple symbols for action='download' (batch). Example: ['AAPL', 'MSFT', '005930.KS']. A single ticker may be passed as `symbol` instead.

period.description: history/download period. Use ONLY a value from the enum (no in-between buckets exist). For an in-between range, pick the next larger enum value and cap rows with limit. Max limits per interval: 1m=7 days / 2m,5m,15m,30m,90m=60 days / 60m,1h=730 days / 1d and above=unlimited. Defaults to 1mo if omitted.

interval.description: history/download candle interval. Defaults to 1d (daily) if omitted.

start.description: history start date (YYYY-MM-DD). When used together with period, start/end takes precedence.

end.description: history end date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today if omitted.

statement.description: Financial statement type for the financials action. income=income statement / balance=balance sheet / cashflow=cash flow statement. Defaults to income if omitted.

frequency.description: financials frequency. Defaults to annual if omitted.

optionDate.description: Expiration date for the options action (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to the nearest expiration if omitted.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows for history/dividends/news/recommendations (caps large timelines, saves tokens). Defaults to 50 if omitted.

output.description: Result shape varies by action. action='quote' → object {symbol, price, change, changePct, marketCap, peRatio, ...} / action='history'·'financials'·'income-statement' 등 → array [{...}, ...] (재무제표 = [{날짜: 값, _index: 항목명}, ...]). 액션마다 object 또는 array.
